threat_event: Ransomware on the farm laptop encrypts local files and steals the passwords saved in the browser
threat_source: Cybercriminal ransomware group (phishing email or a download by a family member)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptop shared with family under one administrator account; every farm password saved in the browser; no backup of local or cloud files; no security training
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-03 laptop; SYS-02 files; every account whose password is saved
likelihood_basis: EV-020 (shared administrator account; passwords in the browser; no backup); EV-016 (no file version history); EV-029 (no security training); EV-035 (family use of the laptop)
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption; automatic updates; built-in antivirus
treatment_plan: Separate standard user accounts for family; password manager and clear the browser store; versioned business file plan plus encrypted backup drive; free security course; P08 runbook

threat_event: Takeover of the SYS-01 administrator account: attacker stops or starts irrigation, changes fertigation or freeze-alarm settings, or deletes field records
threat_source: Cybercriminal using a stolen or reused password
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Password only on SYS-01 although MFA is offered; same password on the booking platform; password saved in the shared laptop browser; activity log never reviewed
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; SYS-06 pump and pivot; BP-01; BP-03
likelihood_basis: EV-002 (password-only SYS-01 sign-in; MFA off); EV-020 (password flagged as reused; saved in the browser); EV-003 (no log review on record)
existing_controls: Freeze alarm texts; manual Hand-Off-Auto switches
treatment_plan: Turn on MFA with an authenticator app; unique passphrase in a password manager; monthly activity log review (weekly in freeze season); local/remote selector to remote only when needed on freeze nights

threat_event: A freeze-night alarm does not arrive (internet, cellular, or SYS-01 outage, or sensor failure) and the strawberries freeze
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The freeze alarm has a single path (sensor to SYS-01 cloud to a text message); no written freeze-night procedure
likelihood_basis: EV-004 (single alarm path to one phone); EV-030 (no freeze-night procedure found); EV-034 (about 2 hours from alarm to sprinklers)
existing_controls: Owner checks the forecast each evening in season
treatment_plan: Standalone cellular freeze alarm that calls the owner and the mutual-aid neighbor; written freeze-night procedure posted in the pump house; hand-start the sprinklers on any forecast freeze night

threat_event: The irrigation dealer's technician account is misused or its credentials are stolen, and irrigation settings are changed
threat_source: Supply chain (dealer staff or an attacker who compromises the dealer)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on technician account with full irrigation control since 2024; no review; no security terms in the dealer agreement
likelihood_basis: EV-001 (always-on technician account; no review on record); EV-008 (no security terms in the dealer agreement)
treatment_plan: Viewer role except during owner-approved service windows; ask the dealer to use MFA; add security terms (named technicians, MFA, change notice, prompt incident notice) at renewal

threat_event: Someone on the farm-stand customer Wi-Fi reaches the pump controller's local page with the default password and changes pump, fertigation, or freeze-zone settings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One flat network for customer Wi-Fi, the laptop, and the pump controller; Wi-Fi password posted at the stand; pump controller default password (found in P07 testing 2026-07-16); router default admin password
likelihood_basis: EV-022 (one network; router default admin password); EV-009 (Wi-Fi password posted at the stand); EV-IA-5 and EV-SC-7 (P07 tests 2026-07-16: pump controller default password reached from the customer Wi-Fi)
existing_controls: Router blocks inbound traffic from the internet
treatment_plan: Change the pump controller and router default passwords (dealer visit); guest isolation for customer Wi-Fi; separate network for the pump house

threat_event: The owner-operator is suddenly unavailable (illness, injury, travel) on a freeze night, at harvest, or in a crisis, and nobody can run the farm or reach its accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One person holds every role, credential, and skill; manual procedures not written; no mutual-aid arrangement
likelihood_basis: EV-034 (owner performs every function; only alarm recipient); EV-030 (no written procedures or mutual-aid arrangement found)
treatment_plan: Written mutual-aid arrangement with a neighboring grower; freeze-night procedure in the pump house; sealed recovery codes and emergency access sheet with the owner's attorney (P05)

threat_event: Farm records are lost (vendor failure, account deletion, ransomware) and the farm cannot show its qualified exemption or support a crop insurance claim
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SYS-01 never exported; cloud files without version history; qualified exemption sales records only in SYS-09 and SYS-10; no 2026 annual eligibility review written
likelihood_basis: EV-005 (no SYS-01 export); EV-016 (no file version history); EV-023 (exemption sales records only in SYS-09 and SYS-10); EV-030 (no 2026 eligibility review found)
existing_controls: Vendors back up their own platforms; paper copies of program documents
treatment_plan: Monthly export of SYS-01, booking sales, and accounting reports to the business file plan and an encrypted backup drive; written annual eligibility review each January

threat_event: A fake invoice or changed bank details redirect a payment (custom harvest operator, landowner, or supplier) or the peanut settlement
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Payments arranged by email; no call-back rule; email MFA by text message only
likelihood_basis: EV-019 (payments arranged by email); EV-030 (no call-back rule found); EV-016 (email MFA by text message)
existing_controls: Email MFA (text message); bank one-time code before a new payee
treatment_plan: Call-back rule on a known number before any change of bank details; move email MFA to an authenticator app

threat_event: Takeover of the booking platform admin account: customer list exported, website changed, refunds or fake reservations issued
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Password only; same password as SYS-01; nobody reviews sign-in history
likelihood_basis: EV-011 (password-only booking admin; no sign-in review on record); EV-020 (password reused with SYS-01)
existing_controls: Payments on the vendor's hosted page; vendor stores customer passwords
treatment_plan: Unique passphrase and MFA; monthly sign-in history review; register the farm's breach contact with the vendor

threat_event: A breach is not recognized, or a Florida notice deadline is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan, contact list, or breach procedure; no record of which vendors hold personal information
likelihood_basis: EV-030 (no incident plan, contact list or breach procedure found); EV-036 (owner did not know the farm is a covered entity)
treatment_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and notification matrix; print contacts; list vendors that hold personal information and their notice contacts

threat_event: AI yield vendor uses farm imagery and yields for its own models, and over-forecasts lead to overbooked U-pick weekends
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Trial on click-through terms that allow secondary use of farm data; forecasts used directly to set reservation slots
likelihood_basis: EV-032 (terms allow model training on farm data); EV-031 (forecasts set the reservation slots); EV-012 (refunds on 2 weekends)
existing_controls: Owner walks the rows before opening slots
treatment_plan: Opt out of model training or negotiate terms, or stop; cap slots at a share of the forecast until checked against field counts (P10)

threat_event: Malware enters through a USB stick from the tractor guidance display or the drone memory card
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Files moved between offline equipment and the laptop by USB stick
likelihood_basis: EV-020 (USB transfers from the tractor display; antivirus on); EV-SI-3 (P07 USB stick test)
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Antivirus scans every stick before files are opened (POL-01 9.3)

threat_event: Lightning or a hurricane damages the pump controller, pivot panel, or router
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Field electronics exposed; no surge protection on the pump controller
likelihood_basis: EV-009 (no surge protection; manual switches); EV-035 (field electronics exposed to lightning)
existing_controls: Hand-Off-Auto switches allow manual pumping; equipment insured under the farm policy
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Ask the dealer to quote surge protection at the next service visit

threat_event: SYS-01 vendor outage longer than one day
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS dependency for remote control and records
likelihood_basis: EV-007 (vendor RTO 8 hours and RPO 1 hour); EV-009 and EV-010 (manual operation at the panels)
existing_controls: Vendor availability commitments (SOC 2, P09); manual operation
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Manual operation covers irrigation; monthly export covers records (R-007)

threat_event: W-9 scans or the customer export spreadsheet are exposed from the consumer file account or the laptop after they are no longer needed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No retention or disposal rule; files kept indefinitely in SYS-02 and on the laptop
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02; SYS-03; personal information of 2 individuals; customer contact list
likelihood_basis: EV-016 (W-9 scans and customer export in SYS-02); EV-020 (customer export in the laptop downloads); EV-030 (no retention or disposal rule found)
treatment_plan: Keep W-9 data only in the accounting SaaS; delete the scans and old customer exports; disposal rule in POL-01 8.6
